tagline: Online ordering with table QR codes. 0% commission.

steps.text: This is ServeFlow: online ordering for cafés and restaurants, with table QR codes and zero commission. Let's follow one order, from the table to the kitchen.
steps.say: This is Serve Flow. Online ordering for cafés and restaurants, with table Q R codes, and zero commission. Let's follow one order, from the table, to the kitchen.

steps.title: Scan the table QR
steps.text: Your customer scans the QR code on Table 5. The menu opens, with the table number already filled in.
steps.say: Your customer scans the Q R code on table five. The menu opens, with the table number already filled in.

steps.title: Your AI menu helper
steps.text: Not sure what to order? Customers ask the AI menu helper in their own words. It checks your live menu, suggests matching items, and they tap plus to add.

rows.head: Checks your live menu
rows.sub: Prices, options and what's still available today.

rows.head: Matching items, ready to add
rows.sub: The customer taps + to add. It also answers questions about hours, delivery and payment.

steps.title: Make it their way
steps.text: They pick the size, the milk and any extras. The price updates as they go.

steps.title: Check out in seconds
steps.text: Dine-in at Table 5 is already selected. They pay by GCash, bank transfer, or at the counter.
steps.say: Dine-in at table five is already selected. They pay by G Cash, bank transfer, or at the counter.

steps.title: Send the payment screenshot
steps.text: For GCash, they upload the payment screenshot. Their order page updates by itself.
steps.say: For G Cash, they upload the payment screenshot. Their order page updates by itself.

steps.title: Kitchen board: verify
steps.text: In the kitchen, the order appears under Payments. Check the screenshot, then tap Verify payment.

steps.title: Preparing, then ready
steps.text: The order moves to Preparing. When it's done, tap Mark ready.

steps.title: Live order tracking
steps.text: Your customer sees it's ready, right on their phone. No more calling out order numbers.

steps.title: Your AI kitchen co-pilot
steps.text: Running low? Tell the kitchen co-pilot: set ensaymada to 10 left. It prepares the change, and nothing happens until you tap Confirm.
steps.say: Running low? Tell the kitchen co-pilot. Set ensaymada to ten left. It prepares the change, and nothing happens until you tap, Confirm.

steps.title: QR codes for every table
steps.text: Print a QR code for every table, and share your store link on Facebook, Instagram and Messenger.
steps.say: Print a Q R code for every table, and share your store link on Facebook, Instagram, and Messenger.
